description: This file declares the BridgeStateManagerImpl class, which implements the BridgeStateManager interface for managing network bridge states, including caching and monitoring bridge interfaces.

classes.name: BridgeStateManagerImpl
classes.description: Implements bridge state management by delegating to monitor and reader interfaces, with caching of bridge interface states.

methods.name: BridgeStateManagerImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the monitor and reader for bridge state management.

methods.name: ~BridgeStateManagerImpl
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up event handlers.

methods.name: read_state
methods.description: Reads and caches the current state of a network bridge, returning the list of interfaces.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the last known state of a specified bridge from cache.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Updates the cached state of a specified bridge.
